Based on currently published September 2026 prices, I’d use Desh Pardesh as the price benchmark, but not book it blindly because its ₹58,999/person price excludes flights. A realistic 7-day honeymoon including flights is roughly ₹1.6–2.5 lakh for two.

My purchase benchmark: target ≤₹2 lakh for two, with return flights, 6 nights, private transfers, breakfast and at least one genuinely honeymoon-specific experience included.

Before paying, get the final invoice—not just the headline package price—showing flights, baggage, hotel names/room category, transfers, taxes/TCS, visa/levy, cancellation penalties and emergency support.
